bio: The modern decor, with its sleek design and light, warm tones, is a hit with diners, as are the ambitious, international, seasonal cuisine and fine wines. Tip: At lunchtime, you can put together your own inexpensive three-course menu or simply order à la carte. For those hot summer days, one of the dining rooms is air-conditioned, but if you would rather sit outside, there is a lovely garden terrace tucked away behind the building. Overnight accommodation is also available....
